title: Get Data from Prometheus — get_data
text: Downloads readings sensors Pimoroni Enviro Enviro+ Prometheus, 1000 points time start_time end_time.

title: Get Data from Prometheus — get_data
code: get_data(   start_time = format(Sys.time() - 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz =     "UTC"),   end_time = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),   urlq )

what: Run the Pimoroni Enviro app — pimoroni
title: Run the Pimoroni Enviro app — pimoroni
text: Starts Shiny app readings Pimoroni Enviro Enviro+ sensors exported Prometheus: gauges latest readings Current tab, chart per sensor Time Series tab. app dark mode, switched button right navbar.

title: Run the Pimoroni Enviro app — pimoroni
code: pimoroni(   prometheus_url,   timezone = "Europe/Bucharest",   analytics = FALSE,   onStart = NULL,   options = list(),   enableBookmarking = NULL,   uiPattern = "/",   ... )

title: Run the Pimoroni Enviro app — pimoroni
text: prometheus_url Character vector Prometheus query_range urls, one per device, "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1507/api/v1/query_range". timezone time zone readings shown , app runs. analytics TRUE add Google Analytics, cookie banner shared sites sedzinfo.github.io, loads visitor accepts. Meant public deployment (see app.R); default, running app sends nothing. onStart See shiny::shinyApp(). options See shiny::shinyApp(). enableBookmarking See shiny::shinyApp(). uiPattern See shiny::shinyApp(). ... options passed golem::with_golem_options().

title: Run the Pimoroni Enviro app — pimoroni

Plot Gauge — plot_gauge
text: Plots last reading one sensor gauge, ideal range green short note gas particle sensors measure. gas sensors fixed range, gauge scaled readings data: spans lowest highest reading, widened one standard deviation, green band mean plus minus one standard deviation, delta difference mean.
